 SUBJECT : Response to email dated 14 September 2020 for submission of document with respect to request dated 4 September 2020 for registration of Loan Agreement dated 2 5 August 2020 executed by and between Zameen Limited and Zameen Media (Private) Limited. 
 
 Dear Sir, 
 
 We write with reference to the application dated 4 September 2020 (“ Original Request ”), along with letter dated 10 September 2020 submitted to J S Bank Limited, Plot No. 14-A, Block D-1, Ghalib Road, Gulberg III, Lahore Branch (“ Authorized Dealer ”), for registration of the Loan Agreement dated 25 August 2020 (“ Loan Agreement ”) executed by and between Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) and Zameen Limited (“ Lender ”). 
 
 With respect to the Original Request, the Authorized Dealer issued instructions to the Borrower vide its email dated 14 September, 2020, wherein the Borrower has been instructed to submit the group structure and shareholding pattern identifying ultimate beneficial ownership of the Lender. 
 
 Copy of the Authorized Dealer’s email dated 14 .09.2020 is enclosed herewith as Annexure A . 
 
 In response to the Authorized Dealer’s instructions, please note the following: 
 
 Group structure of the L ender is attached as Annexure B , wherein all shareholders of the Lender are listed. 
 
 Frontier Digital Ventures Limited, which holds 30% shares of the Lender , is a public listed company registered under the laws of Australia, and listed on the Australian Stock Exchange. All information related to its incorporation and investment portfolio, including its financial statements are available on the Australian Securities Exchange ( https://www.asx.com.au/asx/share-price-research/company/FDV ), Australian Securities and Investments Commission ( https://aus.databasesets.com/aus-company/acn/609183959 ) and its own website ( https://frontierdv.com/our-portfolio/ ) , respectively. The incorporation details and investment portfolio , wherein the Borrower is shown as an investee, are attached as Annexure C . 
 
 IZH Holdings Limited , which holds 70% shares of the Lender , is a private limited company incorporated under the laws of the United Kingdom . The pattern of shareholding of IZH Holdings Limited is enclosed herewith as Annexure D . 
 
 EMPG Holdings Limited, which holds 100% shares of IZH Holdings Limited, is a private limited company incorporated under the laws of Dubai International Financial Center (DIFC), Dubai, UAE . The pattern of shareholding of EMPG Holdings Limited is enclosed herewith as Annexure E . 
 
 We hope the above meets your requirements and that our application for registration of the Loan Agreement and remittance of the Loan Amount to the Borrower’s designated bank account maintained with the Authorized Dealer can be processed expeditiously . 
 
 Should you require any further clarification, p lease do not hesitate to contact us. 
 
 
 Yours sincerely,
